name: Zip-Codes.com
description: US street address standardization (ZIP+4) and US/Canadian postal code lookup, radius search, distance, 2010–2026 Census TIGER/Line boundaries and 2011–2024 ACS survey estimates, over stateless Streamable HTTP (keyless demo; 2,500 credits/day with a free key).

inputs.label: Zip-Codes.com API Key
inputs.description: Optional. Without a key the server runs in demo mode: real values, deeper fields withheld. A free key gives 2,500 credits a day.

obtain.instructions:
1. Open www.zip-codes.com/api/signup
2. Create a free account
3. Copy your API key

auth.instructions: Works without a key in demo mode. Add a Zip-Codes.com API key in the X-Api-Key header for full answers.
